prompt: Oil portrait by Johannes Vermeer, Hyperrealistic portrait of a majestic Umbrella Cockatoo facing forward, its soft, pure white plumage and gracefully curved crest perfectly illuminated. Its expressive dark eyes radiate intelligence and charm, gazing directly at the viewer with an air of quiet nobility. The cockatoo is dressed in an elegant, soft eggshell-yellow Rococo-style men's suit, featuring a richly embroidered waistcoat, intricate ivory lace cuffs, and a flowing silk cravat. The coat is adorned with delicate gold embroidery and fine pearl buttons, exuding aristocratic refinement. A layered lace cravat with a single sapphire brooch rests gently against its chest, enhancing its regal elegance. The cockatoo wears an opulent golden crown, encrusted with shimmering gemstones--sapphires, emeralds, and rubies--reflecting the light with a majestic glow. The background is a muted gray with subtle, ornate golden patterns, adding a touch of classic sophistication without overwhelming the scene. The gentle diffused lighting enhances the soft luminosity of the eggshell-yellow fabric, creating a romantic, ethereal feel. Ultra-high resolution, incredibly detailed, lifelike rendering. --ar 3:4 --stylize 750 --v 6.1
